ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: Mountains and waters names the visible landscape, or its mountains and waters considered together.
EvidenceBody: Yang Jie speaks of roaming landscapes; Huangbo coordinates mountain as mountain and water as water; Zhuanyu denies that represented mountains and waters simply are the things; a parallel record preserves Yang Jie's exchange.

Senses.Note: 7 exact witnesses from 7 independent works delimit this sense.
